decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that fits the firm's established flooring offer, supports customer relationships and margins, and is easily carried with available slack.
A maintenance oil line complements the firm's oiled floors, generates recurring sales close to the core business, and gives management no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.
The care product line for oiled floors builds on established know-how and the firm's after-sales relationships, so it likely meets aspirations at little cost.
An underlay with moisture protection is a standard system accessory that supports installers and retailers, and dropping it would weaken the complete-system offer.
A high-density underlay is a low-risk accessory, though it may overlap with Product D, which makes it slightly more likely to be pruned from the range.
The oak parquet line is the core of the business and central to its design breadth, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn within a year of launch.
